snippet.title: Corner Quest | Idle Auto-Battler on Your Desktop - Demo 2.0 Trailer (November 2026)
snippet.description:
Play the free demo and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4254260/Corner_Quest/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer

Corner Quest is an idle auto-battler that lives in the corner of your screen. A lone Mage fights against endless waves while you work. Check in to upgrade her Spells, pick their Forms, socket rare Runes that reshape them, and Awaken stronger when she falls.

In Corner Quest Demo 2.0:
- Three Biomes over 15 waves, then Endless
- Nine Spells, each with two Forms that change how it behaves
- Runes: rare drops that reshape a Spell
- Reactions: fire and ice on one enemy set off Melt, Overload, Conduct or Fracture
- Awakening and the Garden, with the Frost Slime familiar
- Focus and Surge, full gamepad support

Footage from demo build 2.0.2, with the rebuilt Spells tab.

Free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4285670/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer
Play in your browser on itch: https://ebon-forge-games.itch.io/cornerquest

Follow on X: https://x.com/EbonForgeGames
Follow on Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/ebonforgegames.bsky.social

#CornerQuest #IdleGame #IndieGame
